dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple light-toned irregular perimeters with high-gradient transitions from low-intensity dark exterior to high-intensity interior; includes a prominent 'C' shaped structure in the mid-posterior region and several 'O' shaped structures along the dorsal midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity dark pixel clusters forming a contiguous macro-pattern across the dorsal flank; sparse high-intensity light pixel blobs are localized between larger annuli structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli form a non-equilateral quadrilateral spatial relationship across the mid-dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct reddish-hue cluster on the distal edge of the left pectoral flipper, indicating localized surface trauma or exposed tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Large-scale low-intensity dark pigmentation region forming a macro-scale 'saddle' pattern against the lighter lateral background.
